name: EleFormInsights Form Analytics for Elementor
author: Sascha

sections.description:
Stop jumping between tools to understand your forms.

Every business that collects data through Elementor forms faces the same challenge: Where are my submissions? How are my forms performing? When do I get the most entries? Am I missing important patterns?

EleFormInsights solves this. Instead of digging through the database or jumping between plugins, you get a complete analytics dashboard built right into your WordPress admin.

See Your Forms in Real Time

The moment someone submits a form, you see it reflected in your dashboard. Get instant visibility into:

  • Performance at a glance — Today, last 7 days, and 30-day metrics with trend indicators (up or down)
  • Top performing forms — Which forms are generating the most submissions?
  • Peak submission times — See exactly when your visitors are most engaged with hourly distribution charts
  • Submission trends — Beautiful line charts show you patterns over time so you can spot opportunities
  • Individual entries — Browse all submissions with automatic email detection and easy scanning
  • Custom date ranges — Analyze any 7-day to 1-year period to find insights that matter to you

Take Action on Your Data

  • Export submissions to CSV for deeper analysis in your favorite tools
  • Filter by individual form to focus on what matters
  • Identify bottlenecks, peak times, and optimization opportunities
  • Make data-driven decisions about your marketing and lead generation

Works seamlessly with Elementor Pro. No coding required. No expensive third-party analytics tools needed. Just install, activate, and start analyzing.

Requirements

  • Elementor Pro (Form widget required)
  • WordPress 6.0+
  • PHP 7.4+

Getting Started

Once activated, head to your WordPress Dashboard and look for the new “Form Analytics Overview” widget.

You’ll see:
1. KPIs — Today’s submissions, last 7 days, and last 30 days with trend indicators
2. Top Forms — A table showing your best-performing forms
3. Hourly Chart — When do people submit? Visual breakdown by hour
4. Trends — A line chart showing submission patterns over time
5. Entries — Browse individual submissions with email detection

Start by selecting a form or date range to dive deeper into your data.

Use Cases

  • Lead Generation — Track which forms bring in the most inquiries
  • Landing Page Testing — Compare forms across different pages or campaigns
  • Performance Monitoring — Spot drop-offs and optimization opportunities
  • Reporting — Export data for client reports or management presentations
  • Trend Analysis — Identify patterns and peak engagement times
sections.installation:
1. Download and extract the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate in WordPress Admin → Plugins
  3. That’s it! Your Form Analytics Dashboard appears immediately

No configuration needed. No external API accounts. Just data from your own Elementor forms.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

Yes. This plugin reads data from Elementor Pro’s Form widget. You need at least one form submission recorded to see the dashboard.

Is my data secure?

Absolutely. This plugin only reads data from your WordPress database. It doesn’t modify, delete, or send data anywhere. All your form submissions stay on your server.

Where does the data come from?

EleFormInsights analyzes submissions stored in your WordPress database (the wp_e_submissions table that Elementor creates automatically).

Who can see the analytics dashboard?

Only administrators (users with manage_options capability) can access the dashboard.

Can I export the data?

Yes! Export any form’s submissions for any date range to CSV format. Perfect for further analysis, reporting, or integration with other tools.

Does this slow down my site?

No. The plugin only reads database records and displays them on the admin dashboard. It has minimal performance impact.

Can I filter submissions by specific forms?

Yes! Select any of your Elementor forms to view submissions for just that form, or view all forms combined.
